name: Dissonant Whispers
summary: Wis save or 3d6 Psychic and it spends its Reaction fleeing from you; half damage on a success.
text: A creature you can see within range hears a grating, discordant tune inside its head. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its Reaction, if it has one, to move as far from you as it can by the safest path. On a success it takes half as much damage and nothing else happens. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
